entity.name: Dr Mahmood Ahmad
entity.description: Independent maintainer of open evidence-synthesis research software. Professionally employed as a Specialist in Cardiology at Royal Free London NHS Foundation Trust, UK. This funding request is independent and does not represent employer sponsorship or a university appointment.

projects.name: AllMeta
projects.description: MIT-licensed browser-based evidence-synthesis software. Funding would support maintainable statistical validation, reproducible reference fixtures, accessibility, documentation and open teaching examples. Existing software and replay tests are research-stage outputs; independent prospective accuracy, clinical readiness and superiority to other tools are not claimed.

channels.description: Contact the maintainer to agree lawful grant administration and payment. Any required banking and tax documents would be supplied privately to an agreed funder; no banking details are published here.

plans.name: AllMeta: open validation and maintenance pilot
plans.description: A proposed 12-month, part-time work package: USD 8,000 for 20 maintainer delivery days at USD 400/day; USD 1,000 for independent methodological checks; USD 1,000 for reproducibility infrastructure and accessibility resources. Deliverables: documented reference fixtures and regression checks for priority analysis workflows; clearer import/error handling and accessibility; worked public-data examples and a maintenance report. The package pays the maintainer for delivery time. External review and rate/cost eligibility remain subject to funder agreement. Other funding applications may cover related work; overlapping tasks and costs will be removed or reconciled before accepting multiple awards. Funding buys no favourable scientific findings, exclusive rights or equity.
